summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K to report the commercial launch of its all-new Li L9 vehicle, available in two trims at RMB459,800 and RMB509,800, with deliveries starting May 17, 2026. This is a routine product announcement by an operating company, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, or other event-driven corporate action is disclosed. As a foreign private issuer, the 6-K substitutes for a domestic press release but does not alter the classification. The filing is a standard operating update with no special-situation elements.
